end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value boxes and breaking numbers into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones. Diya identified some place-value parts, but joined spoken number parts incorrectly, and this mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise one number at a time by writing each place-value digit separately before writing the whole numeral.
